work_package: B3-LM (early TOPP bundle, wave 1 carried into wave 2)
method: Differential of the Levenberg-Marquardt evaluation budget. The shipped backend, src/math/fitters/levenberg_marquardt.rs::minimize (the Eigen/MINPACK transcription), is driven with the GaussTraceFitter and EGHTraceFitter functors written out from the pinned source, and its status, residual-evaluation count (nfev), Jacobian-evaluation count (njev) and fitted parameters are compared with the C2 class-level oracle at every max_fev from 1 to 500. The Gauss, Gamma, Gumbel and Gumbel maximum-likelihood fitter problems, which have no C++ budget sweep, are checked against Eigen's counting rule. The levenberg-marquardt =0.14.0 adapter evaluated under decision D2 is kept as an ignored gate report; it failed the gate and is not the backend.
evidence_tier: tier 1 (executed differential against the C2 oracle: 62 trace fits, 29,004 budgets; status, nfev and njev exact, x within 1e-9 relative with a 1e-12 absolute floor) for minimize's evaluation accounting and termination order; tier 4 (Eigen's counting rule, derived from LevenbergMarquardt.h) for the 16 distribution-fitter fits over max_fev 1..500; measurement only (ignored test) for the rejected levenberg-marquardt candidate

context_sources.role: Eigen 5.0.1 as the C2 oracle compiled it (recorded in the C2 manifest eigen_replica): nfev = 1 after the start (line 182), nfev += df_ret for numerical Jacobians (205), njev++ for analytic ones (207), ++nfev per trial (262), maxfev tested after the ftol/xtol tests (315)

crates.io levenberg-marquardt 0.14.0 (Cargo.lock checksum 384ced02a6ac2eb8879d8bd86b46b88e133fa09ffe60d8307263b013ee3ceff2), read for the candidate adapter: max_fev = patience * (n + 1), jacobian() only at accepted points, residuals() returning None stops without restoring the trial parameters
the crate's pivoted QR: a pivot counts as zero only when exactly zero (r_rank), unlike Eigen's thresholded ColPivHouseholderQR::rank

context_sources_note: Third-party sources outside the OpenMS pin, cited for the accounting and the measured differences; neither is ported.

fixtures.role: oracle-generated (tier 1 executed differential) for x; adapted (the C2 optimize_ replica, equal to the library fit bit for bit at every recorded budget) for status, nfev and njev. 8 GaussTraceFitter_test/EGHTraceFitter_test fits with their start residuals and Jacobians, 50 FeatureFinderCentroided_1 seed fits with their start residual norms, each swept over max_fev 1..500 (budgets from the natural termination K to 500 compacted into one line after the generator verified they are identical), and 4 degenerate fits at 500. Numbers are IEEE-754 bit patterns. Generated by ../oracle/lm-budget-differential/extract_fixture.py from C2 outputs whose sha256 the C2 manifest records.

reused_fixtures.role: the 1200 samples of the maximum-likelihood fit swept by distribution_fitter_budgets_follow_eigen_accounting

oracle.sdk: product SDK, Debug build of core 4fdec46 (decision D7); traced sources hash-identical to bc9cc12
oracle.debug_only: none: no precondition exit is used; every fit record comes from a completed minimize

comparison.x: relative 1e-9 with an absolute floor of 1e-12 (docs/DIFFERENTIAL_VALIDATION.md per-group rule; the oracle is macOS arm64, the gate Linux x86_64). Measured on dax: largest relative difference 1.83e-10 (6.4e-10 before package B3b-LM-FIDELITY reproduced Eigen’s reduction kernels) (FFC_1 seeds 10, 12, 20, Gauss); the floor is used only by the EGH class-test tau (true value zero, about 4e-15, largest difference 1.01e-15)
comparison.start_evaluations: class-test residuals and Jacobians bit-identical on dax; FFC_1 start residual norms within 5.4e-16 relative (Eigen's vectorized stableNorm)

crate_gate.candidate: levenberg-marquardt =0.14.0 with nalgebra =0.33.3 (default-features = false, alloc + libm), adapter with exact Eigen maxfev emulation, minpack-compat off
crate_gate.accounting: status, nfev and njev equal C2 at 29,003 of 29,004 trace budgets (not degenerate/flat3_gauss: status 4 after 24 evaluations against Eigen's status 2 after 16, consistent with the crate's exact-zero rank against Eigen's thresholded rank) and the transcription at all 8,000 distribution budgets
crate_gate.x_clause: 8,627 of 29,004 trace budgets neither within 1e-12 relative of the transcription nor no further from C2, 19 of them at budget 500 (FFC_1 seeds 10, 12, 20: candidate 2.2e-9 from C2 against the transcription's 1.8e-10); 2,845 of 8,000 distribution budgets beyond 1e-12 of the transcription, with no C++ sweep to decide them. Re-measured on dax after B3b-LM-FIDELITY; the candidate is unchanged and the counts moved because the transcription is closer to C2 than before (B3-LM measured 3,811 and 2,533).
crate_gate.minpack_compat: not closer: re-measured on dax against the B3b-LM-FIDELITY transcription, 8,627 trace budgets fail the x clause again (the same counts as with the feature off: 29,003 accounting, 20,372 within 1e-12, 5 else no further) and the degenerate fit still differs. B3-LM measured 3,811 before the transcription moved.
crate_gate.feature_graph: cargo tree -e features --all-features: nalgebra alloc and libm only, simba libm, no matrixmultiply
crate_gate.speed: release, dax: 62 trace fits at budget 500 x 200 take 1.51 s (transcription) and 1.20 s (candidate)
crate_gate.re_measured: package B3b-LM-FIDELITY, gate host dax, debug and release identical; release timing 1.24 s transcription against 1.07 s candidate for 200 x 62 fits (was 1.51 s and 1.20 s)

external_reference_note: No C++ and no generator is committed here. The C2 drivers (built and run by package C2 against the product SDK) and the B3-LM fixture generator live under ../oracle/; their sha256 values are recorded so the fixture can be regenerated and audited.

commands: cargo test --locked --no-default-features --features levenberg-marquardt/minpack-compat --test lm_budget_differential (measurement draft of the same gate)
